card.name: Leading digit of a dose number
card.fires_on: The first digit (usually 1) or decimal point of a number that is just starting in a dose table or dosing schedule, right before the rest of the number and a unit like mg or mL.

modes.label: Leading 1 of a dose
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a larger or decimal dose value in a dosing table.
modes.example: 0 mg 5 mg 20 mg 10 mg 40 mg 20 mg 80 mg 40 mg <<1>>60 mg 80 mg

modes.label: Decimal point in a dose
modes.description: The point inside a decimal such as 1.2 or 1.8 in a stepped dosing list.
